# Stephen's Privélessen

> Private tutoring in mathematics, statistics and programming by Stephen, based in Amsterdam and available online. Site: https://stephensprivelessen.nl (Dutch default, English at /en).

## Subjects and levels
- Primary school: arithmetic, language
- Secondary school: mathematics A/B/C/D, physics, chemistry, English, Dutch, biology, economics, business economics
- MBO: mathematics (rekenen)
- Higher education (HBO/university): mathematics, statistics (e.g. SPSS), programming (Python, R)

## Booking
- Contact page: https://stephensprivelessen.nl/contact
- The first trial lesson (30 minutes) is free.

## Availability
Monday-Thursday in person in Amsterdam 18:00-21:00, weekends online only.

## Rates
Regular lessons: rate on request.
Urgent or last-minute? I rarely take rush requests anymore. If it really can't wait, a rush session (max. 2 hours) costs EUR 180 for secondary school and EUR 250 for higher education (university/HBO).
